speaker: kael_prisoner
text: You walked in. Good. They said you wouldn't. The cell is cold but the door is unlocked — it has always been. They want you to stay. The wanting is the lock. Let them want.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: They called it an extraction. That word is an apology I refused to take. We didn't take anything from each other in that room. We gave. Whatever is left is yours now.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: The Warlord asks for the rematch. I decline. The Warlord asks again. I decline again. On the third ask she stops being the Warlord. That is the rematch. Nobody wrote it down.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: The White Oracle sees every outcome. She offers you the comfort of knowing. You decline. You did not come through seven acts of a life to be handed the last page. You came to write it.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: The cell door is still open. I didn't come with you. I couldn't — not yet. But the memory you extracted is mine, and I consent to it being yours. Keep it. Carry it gently.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: They asked me if the procedure hurt. I told them it did. I told them it was supposed to. A memory that costs nothing is not one worth passing along. You will feel the cost. That is the receipt.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: The Warlord asked me, years after, what the third decline cost me. I told her: nothing I needed. She laughed in the way that people laugh when they were hoping to feel forgiven. I did not forgive her. I did sit with her.

speaker: kael_prisoner
text: Lay down the fight. The fight was the extraction. There is no other ending. The Oracle told me this in the last conversation we had — she was wrong about it, but only by one line. Lay down the fight. Pick up the next one when you are ready.
